notes.title: BLOOD SERVANTS REVEAL!
notes.content:
[h3][i]You awaken in prison, hungry, weak, and stripped of all your powers. You do not know what happened. You do not know why you are here.

There is only one thing you do remember: [b]You need to get stronger.[/b][/i][/h3]
[previewyoutube=laHvZ0A6nAU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]We are so excited to announce Blood Servants, a dungeon crawler packed with gorgeous art, epic loot, and of course, baddies to beat up! 

Check out our epic reveal trailer and tell us about your favorite moment, line, easter eggs, or wacky character below! 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979230/Blood_Servants/]Sign up for a closed beta via our Playtest on Steam now![/url][/b][/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979230/Blood_Servants/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/4cb94149b8797264297ed5f5ba11fa57d765602c.gif[/img][/url]

[b]ABOUT THIS GAME[/b]
[list]
[*]Bring up to three friends along for the adventure in 4-player online and couch co-op!
[*] Battle your way through massive hordes of enemies before facing off against intimidating bosses that test just how powerful you think you are!
[*] Make pets out of the various beasts around Khorasan, and team up as they go with you into battle!
[*] Upgrade your stats! Upgrade your gear! Upgrade your skills! Upgrade your town! Ah what the heck, upgrade your pet too! Run out of upgrades? Be reborn to reset your level while keeping your skills and go upgrade some more!
[/list]
[b]WISHLIST AND JOIN OUR DISCORD![/b]

Want more of Blood Servants? Stay up to date on the wild world of Khorasan by joining our Discord, and consider showing some love by wishlisting us on Steam!

[url=https://discord.gg/nd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/aa512b7f59ee551be534c6f6d9cf6b7b66130633.gif[/img][/url]
